{{Dialogue|Captain|You keep watch here, 327.|line2=no|327-T|[annoyed beeps]|Captain|Okay, okay, ''327-T''.|Trooper|You know droids never like to be called by their nicknames.|attr=The trooper and his Captain|audio=327T-CoD.flac|src=<ref name="cod" />}}
Serving in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], a '''clone trooper''' was stationed on the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The ''Tranquility'' was assigned to escort [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] member [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], who had been [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|captured]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] was one of the many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] assigned to the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. During the voyage to Coruscant, [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] in [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|boarding ships]] [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|attacked]] the ''Tranquility''. Later, during a patrol, the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] and [[Unidentified Clone Captain (Tranquility)/Legends|his captain]] entered the [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]] room, where they did not notice anything unusual. The two clones ordered [[327-T/Legends|327-T]], a [[WED-15 Treadwell droid/Legends|Treadwell]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]], to keep an eye on the room before heading for the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] level to repel the remaining Confederate battle droids.

==Biography==
[[File:TranquilityEngRmPatrol-CoD.png|thumb|left|250px|The trooper arrives in the reactor room with his captain.]]
Born on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], created to fight for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="db" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']] was sent to the planet [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]],<ref name="bj">{{TCW|Bombad Jedi}}</ref> where [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] member [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]<ref name="nec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> had been [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|captured]].<ref name="bj" /> The clone trooper was one of the many [[Troop/Legends|troops]] assigned to the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], which would escort Gunray to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="cod" /> The [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]],<ref name="nec" /> however, was sent by<ref name="cod" /> [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] leader [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref> to either [[Death/Legends|kill]] or rescue Gunray, who possessed valuable Confederate secrets.<ref name="cod" />

The Dark Acolyte [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|attacked]] the Star Destroyer with several [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], who penetrated the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of the ''Tranquility'' using [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|boarding ships]]. The [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] then moved toward the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] level of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], where Gunray was being kept. Meanwhile, Ventress infiltrated the ship without being noticed and moved toward the [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]] room of the ''Tranquility'', where the clone trooper and [[Unidentified Clone Captain (Tranquility)/Legends|his captain]] were patrolling. The two clones did not spot the Dark Acolyte, who stealthily planted explosives on the reactors in order to cripple the ship. Not noticing anything unusual,<ref name="cod" /> the two told a [[WED-15 Treadwell droid/Legends|WED-15 Treadwell]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]], [[327-T/Legends|327-T]], inspecting the reactor room<ref name="epguide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode009.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Cloak of Darkness}}</ref> to watch for intruders before locking down the room and leaving for the prison level of the ''Tranquility'', where the remaining battle droids were being repelled.<ref name="cod" />

==Personality and traits==
While in the reactor room of the ''Tranquility,'' when he addressed the droid 327-T with the nickname "327," the captain noted that droids did not like to be called by their nicknames.<ref name="cod" />

==Behind the scenes==
First appearing in "[[Cloak of Darkness]]," an episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]], this trooper was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who also voiced the other clone troopers in the show.<ref name="epguide" />
